title: Sun shadow blockers made shadow-only in 19 MP/coop paks (London Underground library lighting) + Fort stairs / plaster panel materials (map-lighting/apply_map_lighting.py)
notes: Blockers (material shadowblocker / ik-only / canopy-shadow) get +0x20 |= 0x10000 and +0x24 |= 0x101, the retail hidden-blocker rule; without it the sun floods interiors (London library: bright floor, dark walls, hard shafts). Confirmed in game on London. Fort: stone-steps layer swap + PS3 spec terms, plaster-cream border tint, template metalness removed. In place, no size change, idempotent.
